name: Alfrieda
source:
A friend of Aunt Heidi's. She helps Katja trough her ordeal with the troll, but only because she was ordered to do it [spoiler]and because she was promised that she could recover her position as the leader of the Alchemist Hall if she helped him[/spoiler].

[spoiler]She is also an alchemist, and Jakob's sister.[/spoiler]
